# Jordan Ellis / Casey: free two-week trial and next steps (14 Oct 2026)

[[sources/historical_calls/2026-10-14-jordan-ellis-intro-call-155cb165/INDEX|Source index]] · [[sources/intake/records/155cb165d6d1b5b91cb5c08e36671932f815c7626e3cdaa2f6c3f90d67360eba|Original]] · Lines L23-L30
Attributed historical evidence, not canonical TTROS truth.

## Summary
Jordan asked about cost. Casey offered a free two-week trial so Jordan can see his missed-call numbers before paying. Both made a commitment for the Friday after the call, and the paid plan is left open until the trial ends.

## Points
- **Jordan Ellis:** asked what it costs (L23).
- **Casey Linden:** offered a free two-week trial to show the missed-call numbers first (L24).
- **Jordan Ellis:** accepted a free trial and wants Priya to see the reports (L25).
- **Casey Linden:** said Priya can have her own login (L26).
- **Casey Linden:** said the paid plan would be discussed if the numbers look bad after two weeks (L29).

## Commitments and open loops
- **Casey Linden:** send the setup link and a draft text message, by Friday (L27).
- **Jordan Ellis:** send the phone provider details, before Friday (L28).
- **Open:** whether Jordan moves to the paid plan after the trial (L29-L30).

## Key quotes
> "We'd start with a free two-week trial so you can see the missed-call numbers first." (Casey Linden, L24)
> "I'll get our phone provider details to you before then." (Jordan Ellis, L28)

## Caveats
No price was stated. "Friday" is as stated on a 14 Oct 2026 call; the exact date is not given. Priya's surname and role are not stated.
